x: R.Switzer continued to shew improvement by clocking 15.54 to finish sixth. J.G.Coleman and R.Middleton were 1st and 2nd respectively in the 2 miles handicap at the Vickers Armstrong meeting at Weybridge on the 29th of June.
Moreover most of our men reported fit and well, although we should have liked to have seen Bob Newson, Syd James and Roy Switzer in the field.
